title: Monochrome Exploration
paragraphs: This series of charcoal still lifes, drawn from both life and photographs, explores the possibilities of black-and-white mediums. Working with compressed, vine, powdered, and pencil charcoal, I experimented with a range of techniques to achieve varied tonal contrasts, textures, and levels of detail. Several pieces also incorporate ink, introducing a fluid, unpredictable quality that plays against charcoal's more structured mark-making.
